# Björn Eberhardt – Leben

> Vector search engine and curated content-card API for Björn Eberhardt's portfolio page (leben.8bj.de). Semantic search over profile "tiles" (documents and links) with multilingual support and an LLM-friendly TOON output format.

Base URL: **https://leben.8bj.de** — all paths below are relative to it.

## Public Search Endpoint: `GET /api/tiles`

Semantic vector search over all visible cards. No authentication required.

### Query Parameters (with defaults)
- `q`="": Vector search query string (examples: 'contact', 'vision', 'sport', 'finance', '2025 piano concert')
- `similar`="": Alternative to `q`: similarity search by card name (e.g. `similar=finance` returns cards semantically similar to the 'finance' card)
- Omitting both `q` and `similar` lists all cards in curated order (`sort_order`)
- `offset`=0: Number of cards to skip for pagination
- `limit`=20: Number of cards to return (set `limit=0` to return all cards)
- `lang`=de: Language preference. Primary: 'de', 'en'. Translations also exist for fr, es, pl, ro, sq, tr, ru, uk, ar
- `detail`=snippet: Output detail level
  - min: metadata (name, tags, type, score, date)
  - snippet: metadata + short summary cropped to 70 chars
  - summary: metadata + full high-level summary
  - full: metadata + full summary + full article body / HTML teaser / link
- `format`=json: Response format ('json' or 'toon'). TOON can also be selected via HTTP header `Accept: text/x-toon`; the response is then `text/plain` with header `X-LLM-Format: TOON`
- `crop`=0: Optional character count limit for summary/doc (default 70 when `detail=snippet` and `crop=0`)

### Headers
- `X-Reference: <code1>,<code2>`: Optional. Unlocks cards gated by a `secret` reference code (e.g. shared private links).
- `Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>`: Optional. Only relevant for admins: makes invisible/secret cards visible in results (see [/llms-admin.txt](https://leben.8bj.de/llms-admin.txt)).

### JSON Response Shape
`{"status":"success","query":"...","lang":"de","format":"json","count":3,"data":[Tile...],"items":[TOON items...]}`
- Each Tile has: `id`, `name`, `language`, `tags` (comma string), `title`, `html_teaser`, `summary`, `link`, `type` ("doc"|"link"), `content_file`, `visible`, `accent_color`, `background`, `sort_order`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, and `score` (0..1; only set when a vector search matched).
- `items` is the TOON representation of the same result set (see below).

### Card Reference Types
- `doc(size)`: HTML partial stored on the server, size in bytes
- `link`: external URL

### Similarity Score
- 1.00: Exact semantic match
- 0.80 - 0.99: High relevance

## Other Public Endpoints
- `GET /api/tiles/:name?lang=de`: Fetch details for a specific card by name (falls back to another language if requested language is missing)
- `GET /api/tiles/:name/versions`: Fetch available language versions for a specific card → `{"status","name","versions":[TileSummary...]}`
- `GET /api/healthz`: Liveness/readiness probe → `{"status":"ok","db":"ok","time":"..."}` (HTTP 503 if the database is down)
- `GET /llms.txt` (this file) and `GET /llms-admin.txt`: machine-readable API documentation
- `GET /api/mcp`: MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint — **requires an admin token** (see llms-admin.txt)

### Errors
All errors are JSON: `{"status":"error","message":"..."}`. Unknown card → HTTP 404. Missing/invalid admin token on protected endpoints → HTTP 401.

### Example API Queries
- Vector Search: [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=finance+investments&limit=3&lang=de](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=finance+investments&limit=3&lang=de)
- Similarity Search by Card: [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?similar=finance&limit=3&lang=de](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?similar=finance&limit=3&lang=de)
- Explore All Cards: [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?limit=0&detail=min&lang=en](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?limit=0&detail=min&lang=en)
- Full document: [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=vision&limit=1&detail=full&crop=4000&lang=en](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=vision&limit=1&detail=full&crop=4000&lang=en)
- TOON Text Format: [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=vision&format=toon](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=vision&format=toon)

## TOON Output Format
`?format=toon` (or `Accept: text/x-toon`) returns results as tabular plain text: a commented header line naming the fields, then one row per card. Token-efficient for LLM consumption. Use `detail` and `crop` as with JSON.

---

## Admin Endpoints
For administrative capabilities (device-flow authentication, token management, card CRUD, translation, background tasks, content files, images & assets, MCP), see [/llms-admin.txt](https://leben.8bj.de/llms-admin.txt).
